g.text: four everyday document jobs, and nobody can check the output by hand
A long report becomes a one-page summary
Did it keep the one paragraph
two hundred of these, and no expert to check them
A technical report becomes a client brochure
traced to a real passage in the report
which claim rests on nothing in the source?
Two versions of the same page
a contract and its revision · a page and its converted markdown
which passages line up, and which quietly do not?
One brief becomes a thousand personalised variants
and the one that drifted looks exactly
personalised campaigns for forty segments · nobody reads a thousand outputs
one question in four coats: how far apart, and which part matches which?
